name: Runtime Truth Projection into the Cockpit
description: The runtime state machine projects its current state, pending transitions, and health into the cockpit UI as an observable stream.
purpose: The cockpit always reflects runtime reality.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime state machine publishes a structured state snapshot on every transition
Cockpit subscribes to the state stream and renders current state in real-time
State includes: phase (boot/active/shutdown), health status per subsystem, pending transitions, error conditions
Stale state detection: if no update within heartbeat interval, cockpit shows "stale" indicator
State projection includes transition history (last N transitions with timestamps)
Cockpit can request a forced state refresh from the runtime
required_evidence: State machine publish test (structured snapshot on every transition)
Stale state detection test (heartbeat interval expiry)
Transition history test (last N transitions with timestamps)
acceptance_gates: State snapshot published on every transition
Cockpit shows real-time state with health per subsystem
Stale state indicator activates when heartbeat misses
rollback_strategy: No state mutation from projection — read-only stream, no rollback needed
recovery_strategy: Reconnect subscription on cockpit restart; runtime always has latest state
escalation_policy: State stream disruption escalates to user with connection diagnostic
